description: Public-release config: industry-intelligence sources fetched on demand by scripts/fetch_industry.py. Cached into cache/industry/ (gitignored, never committed). Raw artifacts archived here are required evidence before any industry.json record is promoted to status=verified.

sources.name: TransformerLens
sources.description: Hook-based activation/weight access for decoder LLMs; the base instrument family this project's deepseek装置 maps onto.

sources.name: SAELens
sources.description: Training sparse autoencoders on transformer activations; SAE-era reference tooling.

sources.name: nnsight / NDIF
sources.description: Remote large-model intervention platform; contrast point for our local-GPU serial discipline.

sources.name: circuit-tracer (Anthropic)
sources.description: Attribution-graph / cross-layer-transcoder circuit tracing released 2025; mainline successor to SAE feature views.

sources.name: Neuronpedia
sources.description: Public SAE feature dictionary browser; the platform we benchmark our evidence-chain view against (they show features, we show how conclusions are sealed).

sources.name: AxBench
sources.description: Steering/recovery benchmark whose sobering SAE results are part of our methods map (simple baselines can beat SAE steering).

sources.name: SAEBench
sources.description: SAE evaluation suite; documented the proxy-metric vs downstream-usefulness gap cited in our gap radar.

sources.name: Transformer Circuits (Anthropic essays)
sources.description: Primary source hub: superposition, toy models, monosemantic features, attribution graphs, persona vectors.

sources.name: arXiv cs.LG interpretability listing
sources.description: Rolling feed used by the weekly industry sweep; entries enter drafts/ only after manual curation.

promotion_rule: industry.json record -> verified requires: (1) source fetched & archived with sha256, (2) claim re-checked against the primary text, (3) correction appended if wording differs.
